Meet the real Pops and Avery

Chris Voigt

For more than 25 years, Chris Voigt has served as the worship pastor at Dayspring Fellowship in Keizer, OR. In 2018, he followed God’s call on his life to become the Lead Pastor, while continuing to lead worship. Chris also leads Chris Voigt Worship, a non-profit focused on equipping and encouraging worship leaders and their teams for healthy and effective ministry. Though focused primarily on ministry in the beautiful Pacific Northwest, his ministry endeavors have impacted churches across the United States and around the world.

Chris is the author of A Little More Today and Everyday Worship as well as the children’s fantasy series, The Ever Song Chronicles. Chris’ greatest joy is his family. He is married to DeeDee and together they love spending time with their grown-up kids, Josh, Lexi, and son-in-law Matt, and most especially, their delightful granddaughter, Avery.
